auto_atlas.max_width_description: Limits the width of each generated atlas. Sprites may be split across multiple atlases when exceeded.
auto_atlas.max_height_description: Limits the height of each generated atlas. Sprites may be split across multiple atlases when exceeded.
auto_atlas.padding_description: Sets the spacing, in pixels, between sprites in the atlas.
auto_atlas.allow_rotation_description: Allows sprites to be rotated while packing to improve space usage.
auto_atlas.force_squared_description: Forces each generated atlas to use equal width and height.
auto_atlas.power_of_two_description: Rounds each generated atlas dimension up to a power of two.
auto_atlas.algorithm_description: Selects the algorithm used to pack sprites into the atlas.
auto_atlas.format_description: Selects the output image format for the generated atlas.
auto_atlas.quality_description: Sets the output image quality from 0 to 100.
auto_atlas.contour_bleed_description: Extends visible edge colors into adjacent transparent pixels to reduce texture filtering artifacts.
auto_atlas.padding_bleed_description: Copies sprite edge pixels into the one-pixel padding area to reduce texture filtering seams.
auto_atlas.filter_unused_description: Includes only sprites referenced by the build in generated atlases. This has no effect during preview.
auto_atlas.remove_texture_in_bundle_description: Removes unused Texture2D resources from the containing Bundle during the build.
auto_atlas.remove_image_in_bundle_description: Removes unused ImageAsset resources from the containing Bundle during the build.
auto_atlas.remove_sprite_atlas_in_bundle_descriptio: Removes unused SpriteAtlas resources from the containing Bundle during the build.
auto_atlas.texture_setting_description: Configures sampling and wrapping for the generated atlas texture.

texture.use_uuid_description: Indicates whether the image reference is a UUID instead of a database URI.
texture.image_uuid_or_database_uri_description: Identifies the ImageAsset used as this texture's source, by UUID or database URI.

gltf.mesh_optimizer_description: Configures optional mesh optimization during model import.
gltf.mesh_optimizer_enable_description: Enables mesh optimization for the imported model.
gltf.simplify_options_description: Configures mesh simplification when the Simplify algorithm is selected.
gltf.enable_smart_link_description: Links matching boundary vertices before simplification to reduce mesh cracks.
gltf.agressiveness_description: Controls how aggressively edges are collapsed. Higher values simplify faster but may reduce quality.
gltf.max_iteration_count_description: Limits the number of mesh simplification iterations.
gltf.mount_all_animations_on_prefab_descripti: Mounts all imported animation clips on the generated prefab's Animation component.
gltf.target_ratio_description: Sets the target ratio for the simplified mesh.

fbx.unit_conversion_description: Selects how model units are handled during FBX-to-glTF conversion.
fbx.match_mesh_names_description: Matches converted mesh names to their original DCC model names.
